name: HHRG Berhad
overview: HHRG Berhad 今年完成收购 Terengganu Marang 一块土地，并终止另一块土地的买卖协议；同时与 RJJ Hotels 的酒店品牌及管理谅解备忘录范围由 Tanjung Residensi 扩大至公司未来指定发展的任何产业。公司亦进行凭单红利发行及 ESOS 新股发行。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比减少 23.4%，净利润同比减少 62.7%。
overview_en: HHRG Berhad completed the acquisition of a piece of land in Marang, Terengganu, and terminated the sale and purchase agreement for another piece of land this year. Meanwhile, the MOU with RJJ Hotels on hotel brand selection and management was expanded from Tanjung Residensi to any property in upcoming development projects earmarked by HHRG for hotel or tourist accommodation. The company also carried out a bonus issue of warrants and new share issuance under ESOS.

segments.name: 房地产
segments.note: 今年完成收购 Terengganu Marang 一块土地，并终止另一块土地的买卖协议；同时与 RJJ Hotels 的酒店品牌及管理谅解备忘录范围扩大至公司未来指定发展的任何产业。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of a piece of land in Marang, Terengganu, and terminated the sale and purchase agreement for another piece of land this year;

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd 的谅解备忘录截至公告日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: No material development pertaining to the MOU with RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd as at the announcement date.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Open Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. 完成收购 Terengganu Marang 一块土地（No. Hakmilik PM 3668, No. Lot 78303）。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Open Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. completed the acquisition of a piece of land in Marang, Terengganu (No. Hakmilik PM 3668, No. Lot 78303).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Open Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. 与 Tregon Construction Sdn Bhd 就另一块土地（No. Hakmilik PM 3669, No. Lot 78304）的买卖协议于 2026 年 8 月 20 日终止，双方同日签订补充函。
actions.text_en: The sale and purchase agreement between Open Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. and Tregon Construction Sdn Bhd for another piece of land (No. Hakmilik PM 3669, No. Lot 78304) was terminated on 20 August 2026, with a supplemental letter entered into on the same date.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd 的谅解备忘录截至公告日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: No material development pertaining to the MOU with RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd as at the announcement date.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd 的谅解备忘录经 2026 年 4 月 17 日函件修订，酒店或旅游住宿的选址由 Tanjung Residensi 改为公司未来指定发展的任何产业。
actions.text_en: The MOU with RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd was amended via letter dated 17 April 2026, replacing the reference to Tanjung Residensi with any property in upcoming development projects earmarked by HHRG for hotel or tourist accommodation.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd 的谅解备忘录涉及 Tanjung Residensi Kuala Terengganu 酒店或旅游住宿的品牌选择及管理，截至公告日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The MOU with RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd concerns the choice of hotel brand and management of hotel or tourist accommodation at Tanjung Residensi Kuala Terengganu; no material development as at the announcement date.
